[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import data.list.filter

def implementation (lst: List Int) : Option Int :=
match lst with
| [] => none
| [x] => none
| x :: y :: tail =>
  let smaller_els := lst.filter (· < x)
  if smaller_els.length > 0 then
    let second_smallest := smaller_els.drop 0.head
    let smaller_els_filtered := smaller_els.filter (· = smaller_els.get! 0)
    if smaller_els_filtered.length = smaller_els.length then
      some second_smallest
    else
      none
  else
    match y < x with
    | true => some y
    | false => implementation (y :: tail)
  | _ => implementation tail
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma filter_smaller_elements
(lst: List Int)
(x: Int)
(smaller_els: List Int)
(h_smaller_els: smaller_els = lst.filter (· < x))
(h_smaller_els_len: 0 < smaller_els.length)
: smaller_els.all (· = smaller_els.get! 0) :=
by
have h_all_eq_first: ∀ y, y ∈ smaller_els → y = smaller_els.get! 0 := by
  intros y h_y_in_smaller_els
  have h_y_le_x: y < x := by
    simp [h_y_in_smaller_els]
  have h_y_eq_x: y = x := by
    linarith [h_y_le_x]
  simp [h_y_eq_x]
exact h_all_eq_first

lemma drop_head_filter
(lst: List Int)
(x: Int)
(smaller_els: List Int)
(h_smaller_els: smaller_els = lst.filter (· < x))
(h_smaller_els_len: 0 < smaller_els.length)
: smaller_els.drop 0.head = x ∧
smaller_els.drop 0 = x :: smaller_els.tail :=
by
have h_head_in_smaller_els: x ∈ smaller_els := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_head_in_smaller_els]
have h_head_eq_x: x = smaller_els.get! 0 := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_head_in_smaller_els]
rw [h_head_eq_x]
have h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail: smaller_els.tail = smaller_els.drop 0 := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_head_in_smaller_els]
rw [h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail]
simp [h_smaller_els]

lemma filter_identical_elements
(lst: List Int)
(x: Int)
(smaller_els: List Int)
(h_smaller_els: smaller_els = lst.filter (· < x))
(h_smaller_els_len: 0 < smaller_els.length)
: smaller_els.all (· = smaller_els.get! 0) →
smaller_els = x :: smaller_els.tail :=
by
have h_all_eq_first: ∀ y, y ∈ smaller_els → y = smaller_els.get! 0 := by
  intros y h_y_in_smaller_els
  have h_y_le_x: y < x := by
    simp [h_y_in_smaller_els]
  have h_y_eq_x: y = x := by
    linarith [h_y_le_x]
  simp [h_y_eq_x]
exact h_all_eq_first
simp [h_all_eq_first]
have h_x_in_smaller_els: x ∈ smaller_els := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_x_in_smaller_els]
have h_x_eq_get_0: x = smaller_els.get! 0 := by
  simp [h_x_in_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_x_in_smaller_els]
rw [h_x_eq_get_0]
have h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail: smaller_els.tail = smaller_els.drop 0 := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_x_in_smaller_els]
rw [h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail]
simp [h_smaller_els]

lemma filter_tail_filter
(lst: List Int)
(x: Int)
(smaller_els: List Int)
(h_smaller_els: smaller_els = lst.filter (· < x))
(h_smaller_els_len: 0 < smaller_els.length)
: smaller_els.tail = (lst.filter (· < x)).tail :=
by
have h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail: smaller_els.tail = smaller_els.drop 0 := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_x_in_smaller_els]
rw [h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail]
simp [h_smaller_els]

lemma drop_head_tail
(lst: List Int)
(x: Int)
(smaller_els: List Int)
(h_smaller_els: smaller_els = lst.filter (· < x))
(h_smaller_els_len: 0 < smaller_els.length)
: smaller_els.drop 0.tail = smaller_els.tail :=
by
have h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail: smaller_els.tail = smaller_els.drop 0 := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_x_in_smaller_els]
rw [h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail]
simp [h_smaller_els]

lemma filter_drop_head_tail
(lst: List Int)
(x: Int)
(smaller_els: List Int)
(h_smaller_els: smaller_els = lst.filter (· < x))
(h_smaller_els_len: 0 < smaller_els.length)
: (smaller_els.drop 0).tail = (lst.filter (· < x)).tail :=
by
have h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail: smaller_els.tail = smaller_els.drop 0 := by
  simp [h_smaller_els]
  simp [List.exists_of_mem h_x_in_smaller_els]
rw [h_tail_eq_smaller_els_tail]
simp [h_smaller_els]
[END]

let result := implementation lst
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
by_cases h_result_none: result = none
-- Case 1: result is none
simp [h_result_none]
apply Not.intro
-- show that there is no 2nd smallest element
intro h_2nd_smallest_exists
have h_2nd_smallest_exists' : ∃ i j, i < lst.length ∧ j < lst.length ∧ i ≠ j ∧ lst.get! i < lst.get! j := by
  simp [h_2nd_smallest_exists]
exact h_2nd_smallest_exists'
-- Case 2: result is some x
simp [h_result_none]
have h_result_some: result = some (implementation lst) := by
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]

  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
have h_result: result = some (implementation lst) := by

simp [h_result]
